title: SUPER LEAGUE ATTP 2025-2026: a season taken to the limit, decided by a single point
excerpt: The Super League ATTP 2025-2026 season ended after eight months of competition, with 8 teams at the start and a final round decided on the finest of margins.
body_html:
The Super League ATTP 2025-2026 season, which began in September 2025 and ended this weekend, has come to a close after eight months of intense matches, confirming its standing as one of the most dynamic and spectacular table tennis competitions in the Republic of Moldova.

Organised by the National Sports Association ATTP and included in the official national sports calendar approved by the Ministry of Education and Research, Super League ATTP once again brought together 8 teams made up of the country’s most dedicated players.

Over the eight months, the competition was marked by heated matches, nerve-shredding finishes and duels of the highest intensity. Broken paddles, rallies fought to the last fraction of a second, moments of tension but also huge joy defined every round. Team spirit was the decisive factor: wherever one player faltered, the whole team felt it.

That reality showed in the final round, where the fragile balance of the squads played a crucial role. The Top Cup team, missing one of its members, had to withdraw from the race at the captain’s decision — a reminder of how much a team’s cohesion and full line-up matter in this format.

The grand final was a true sporting spectacle, with the finalists fighting to the last ball at the highest intensity. In a dramatic finish the title was decided by a single point, with victory going to team LEGEND, led by Master of Sport Serghei Cucerovschii, together with teammates Petru Bulat (Candidate Master of Sport) and Alexandr Bodac.

Second place went to one of the favourites, team FLUMEDFARM, led by Master of Sport Ion Danilov, which delivered a solid performance throughout the season.

FLUMEDFARM’s founder, Igor Bobeico, congratulated the organisers on the high level of the competition and suggested, in a constructive spirit, a more reserved approach to publishing certain information in advance during the next competition cycle. He also made clear his wish to contribute actively to organising and supervising the coming season.

The end of this cycle confirms once again that Super League ATTP is a real test of endurance, character and unity, where every point counts and every team writes its own story over a memorable season.
